sentences.text:
------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioners : Mr. Rohit Ranjan Sinha, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. Om Prakash Tiwari, Advocate ------
Order No.09 Dated- 15.03.2024 I.A. No.4839 of 2023 Heard the parties.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to amend the writ petition by incorporating the additional prayer by holding that the entire land acquisition has been lapsed in terms of the provision of Section 24 (2) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2015 as mentioned in paragraph no. 4 of this interlocutory application, under the heading proposed amendment.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is next submitted that the amendment is necessitated because the petitioners inadvertently missed out the said prayer and the supporting pleading is there in the writ petition.
Learned counsel for the respondents has no objection.

Considering the aforesaid facts, the proposed amendment to this writ petition, as mentioned in paragraph-4 of this interlocutory application is allowed and the petitioners are directed to file a consolidated writ petition incorporating the proposed amendment which is allowed by this order; within three weeks, failing which, this interlocutory application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
This interlocutory application is disposed of accordingly.
